title: "Legend corners"

<!-- VM.ui.legendOverlay in both corners over a Plotly chart with its
     modebar. The check hovers each chart (which shows the modebar) and
     asserts the legend and the modebar don't overlap and that every legend
     row can be clicked, then drags the top-left legend onto the modebar and
     asserts it is moved clear. -->

```{ojs}
//| output: false
VM = window.VM
vmTheme = Generators.observe(notify => VM.plotting.onThemeChange(notify))
chartColors = VM.plotting.colors(vmTheme)
leftPlot = VM.plotting.persistentPlot({height: "360px"})
rightPlot = VM.plotting.persistentPlot({height: "360px"})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
traces = {
  const xs = Array.from({length: 101}, (_, i) => -3 + 6 * i / 100)
  return [
    {name: "first", x: xs, y: xs.map(x => Math.exp(-x * x / 2)), line: {color: chartColors.fn}},
    {name: "second", x: xs, y: xs.map(x => Math.exp(-((x - 1) ** 2) / 2)), line: {color: chartColors.alt}},
    {name: "third", x: xs, y: xs.map(x => Math.exp(-((x + 1) ** 2) / 2)), line: {color: chartColors.ok}}
  ]
}
```

<div class="ojs-chart-block" id="legend-left">

```{ojs}
viewof leftShown = VM.ui.legendOverlay(traces.map(t => ({label: t.name, color: t.line.color})))
```

```{ojs}
leftPlot(traces.map(t => ({...t, visible: leftShown.includes(t.name) ? true : "legendonly"})), {showlegend: false})
```

</div>

<div class="ojs-chart-block" id="legend-right">

```{ojs}
viewof rightShown = VM.ui.legendOverlay(traces.map(t => ({label: t.name, color: t.line.color})), {corner: "top-right"})
```

```{ojs}
rightPlot(traces.map(t => ({...t, visible: rightShown.includes(t.name) ? true : "legendonly"})), {showlegend: false})
```

</div>
